label: The build's choice, an operational default within amendment A1's "rotate faster" (Amendment 13). Vince has not set it and may override it by amendment at any time.
why: Four weeks keeps a leaked set's useful life short while leaving time to harvest and hand-pick 50 to 100 validated tasks for the next one; one week of overlap gives every floor schedule at least seven days of runs on both sets to bridge the chart.
